Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call for streaming-p95 spike on /v1/stream (region: eu-west) — p95 820ms -> 2.4s, p99 5.1s -> 12.3s. SLO breach alert. page_id=INC-20260315-001

emily: I'm on it. seeing a big tail at the streaming gateway. metrics dashboard -> https://redwood.example/dashboards/streaming/p95 (opening).

emily: quick summary: errors are low, connections remain open, but chunk latency grows after ~45s of stream. suggests buffering/backpressure upstream or slow consumer.

sre_jules: reproducing in staging: if we simulate slow client drain (read interval > 250ms) the proxy's internal write buffer grows and we hit socket backpressure -> write() returns EWOULDBLOCK -> proxy stalls.

ops_mira: which proxy? edge-proxy-v2 or legacy-sse-gateway?

emily: edge-proxy-v2 (eu fleet). logs show repeated "write buffer high" and then socket reset 1m later. sample log: ```
2026-03-15T09:07:12Z edge-proxy-v2[pid=1221] WARN write_buffer_bytes=131072 conn=conn-83 write_result=EAGAIN
2026-03-15T09:07:55Z edge-proxy-v2 ERROR conn=conn-83 reason=client_read_timeout
```

ryan_prod: customer_ops reports increased latency for live customers on EU, one 3rd-party integration timed out and retried -> amplification.

customer_ops: we have 2 paying customers affected (acct: acme-inc, acct: lumenai). both report partial transcripts and long hangs. open support tickets referenced in ticketing system.

leah: quick mitigation idea: enable aggressive keepalive probes to detect slow clients sooner + drop connections that exceed 10s stalled write buffer. could push a config change to eu-edge pool.

emily: agree. also toggle short-circuit fallback: route streaming requests older than 20s to non-streaming chunked response (polling) so UI can still show partial results. needs a route-level config flip.

sre_jules: I can push the keepalive change. command: ```infractl proxy update --pool eu-edge --keepalive-interval 10s --max-write-buffer-bytes 65536 --drop-on-stall true```

ops_mira: push that as a canary to 10% of instances first. otherwise risk mass disconnects.

emily: canary start now. ryan, notify the two customers that we're mitigating and may drop long-poll sessions briefly. template: "We've identified streaming stalls causing long tail latency; rolling mitigations that may briefly disconnect sessions, we'll follow up."

ryan_prod: notifying now. posting status update in status.redwood.ai and to customers.

Daniel: while canary runs, I'll enable per-connection rate limiter in the streaming layer to prevent single slow consumers from blocking server-side batching. config snippet: ```
streaming.kv_cache.enabled=true
streaming.rate_limit.per_connection=20kbps
```

leah: also verify proxy keepalive doesn't conflict with mobile clients that use battery-saving TCP clamping. cc @customer_ops for customer-specific workarounds.

customer_ops: noted, will advise ACME to upgrade their SDK read buffer to 64k and to respect keepalive.

Incident Bot: Canary update: keepalive change rolled to 10% (eu-edge). p95 dropped from 2.4s -> 1.1s in canary, p99 still high at ~6.2s.

emily: good signal. continue canary to 50% if no regressions. also enable aggressive KV prefix caching on model-serving side for streaming tails to reduce token generation stalls.

sre_jules: starting canary scale to 50%. also enabling quick KV cache: ```modelsrv --cache-prefix 1h --cache-mode aggressive --max-prefix 5kb```

ops_mira: scaling to 50% now. watch for increased CPU on model-serving hosts.

emily: noticed one trace where model backend queue time spikes (queue_ms 3000) aligned with stream stall. there was a burst of long-running completions (seq len 2048). can we spike autoscaler?

daniel: autoscaler is at 85% in eu model pool. I can temporarily bump reserved capacity and spin up 2 extra replicas (non-preemptible). command run: ```infractl model scale --pool eu-dedicated --instances +2 --reason "live mitigation"```

Incident Bot: autoscale event initiated.

ryan_prod: customer update sent: "We implemented mitigations; you may see brief reconnects. We're monitoring and will follow with RCA." :white_check_mark:

emily: monitoring dashboards. p95 in eu is trending down to 900ms after changes and p99 to 3.4s — still above SLO but improving. keeping on-call until stabilized.

leah: action items for post-incident: 1) increase default write buffer backpressure metrics and auto-detect slow drainers, 2) add client SDK guidance for read buffer sizes and keepalive handling, 3) improve model pool autoscale thresholds to preempt long queueing.

ops_mira: filing follow-ups in GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inc/infra/issues/streaming-stall-mitigation-20260315

emily: handing off to SRE for root-cause and RCA. leaving on-call: emily -> sre_jules. pls keep thread updated. :handoff: 

sre_jules: taking over. will open timeline and assign owners. starting incident doc now.

Incident Bot: Incident acknowledged by sre_jules. severity: Sev2.

emily: thanks everyone. I'll stay available for questions.
